titulo_es.@en: There is no other: - (으) 수밖에 없다

없어서.es: como no hay, como no tengo

받을 수밖에 없어요.en: there's nothing left but to receive it.

탈 수밖에 없었어요.es: no me quedó otra que cogerlo
탈 수밖에 없었어요.en: I had nothing left but to take it.

제출할 수밖에 없어요.es: no me queda otra que entregarlo
제출할 수밖에 없어요.en: I have to hand it over.

끊기다.es: dejar de funcionar, terminar el servicio

막차가.es: el último autobús o tren + 가 (sujeto)

texto.@es: **V-(으)ㄹ 수밖에 없다** expresa que, dadas las circunstancias, no hay otra opción que hacer algo: 받다 → **받을 수밖에 없어요**, 기다리다 → **기다릴 수밖에 없어요**. Se usa **-을** tras consonante y **-ㄹ** tras vocal.
texto.@en: **V-(으)ㄹ 수밖에 없다** expresa que, dadas las circunstancias, no hay otra opción que hacer algo: 받다 → **받을 수밖에 없어요**, 기다리다 → **기다릴 수밖에 없어요**. **-을** is used after consonant and **-ㄹ** after vocal.

texto: 오늘까지 신청해야 해서 지금 **제출할 수밖에 없어요** = tengo que solicitarlo hoy, así que no me queda otra que entregarlo ahora.

titulo.@en: This does not mean a general obligation.

texto.@es: **-아/어야 하다** expresa una obligación o necesidad; **-(으)ㄹ 수밖에 없다** destaca que las opciones están limitadas por la situación.
texto.@en: **-아/어야 하다** expresses an obligation or necessity; **-(으)ㄹ 수밖에 없다** points out that the options are limited by the situation.

texto: 막차가 끊겨서 택시를 **탈 수밖에 없었어요** = como ya no había más autobuses, no me quedó otra que coger un taxi.

filas.@en: there's nothing left but to receive it.
there's nothing left to wait for.
There's nothing left but to hand it over.

frases.es: Hay que entregar la solicitud antes de que termine hoy.
frases.en: We have to hand over the application before it's over today.

frases.ko: 알아요. 시간이 없어서 지금 제출할 수밖에 없어요.
frases.es: Lo sé. No tengo tiempo, así que no me queda otra que entregarla ahora.
frases.en: I know. I don't have time, so I have no choice but to deliver it now.

analisis.@es: no me queda otra que entregarla ahora
analisis.@en: I have to give it now.

pregunta.@en: What does «지금 제출할 수밖에 없어요» express?

texto.@es: Que no hay otra opción que entregarlo ahora.
texto.@en: That there's no choice but to deliver it now.

explicacion.@es: -(으)ㄹ 수밖에 없다 expresa que las opciones son limitadas.
explicacion.@en: - (으) - 수밖에 없다 states that the options are limited.

texto.@en: He can give it up any time he wants.

explicacion.@es: Eso sería 원할 때 내도 돼요.
explicacion.@en: That would be 원할 때 내도 돼요.

texto.@en: That he already handed it over.

pregunta.@es: no me queda otra que entregarlo
pregunta.@en: I have to hand it over.

explicacion.@en: It means he's allowed to turn him in.
It means I want to turn him in.

bloques.frase: 막차가 끊겨서 택시를 탈 수밖에 없었어요.

texto.@es: Como ya no había último autobús, no me quedó otra que coger un taxi.
texto.@en: Since there was no more last bus, I had no choice but to take a taxi.

explicacion.@es: 탈 수밖에 없었어요 presenta una opción inevitable en el pasado.
explicacion.@en: 탈 수밖에 없었어요 presents an inevitable option in the past.

texto.@es: Como había muchos autobuses, cogí uno.
texto.@en: Since there were a lot of buses, I took one.

explicacion.@es: Eso cambia la causa y el medio.
explicacion.@en: That changes the cause and the means.

texto.@en: I didn't want to take a cab.

explicacion.@es: Eso sería 택시를 타고 싶지 않았어요.
explicacion.@en: That would be 택시를 타고 싶지 않았어요.

texto.@en: There's nothing left but to receive it.

explicacion.@es: 받을 수밖에 없다 = no tener otra opción que recibir.
explicacion.@en: 받을 수밖에 없다 = have no choice but to receive.

texto.@en: You can get it if you want.

explicacion.@es: Eso sería 받고 싶으면 받아도 돼요.
explicacion.@en: That would be 받고 싶으면 받아도 돼요.
That would be 어제 받지 않았어요.

traduccion.@es: No queda otra que entregar la solicitud antes de que termine hoy
traduccion.@en: There's no other way than to deliver the application before it's over today.

explicacion.@es: 오늘까지 = hasta hoy. 제출할 수밖에 없어요 = no queda otra que entregarla.
explicacion.@en: 오늘까지 = to date. 제출할 수밖에 없어요 = there is no other choice but to deliver it.

pregunta.@en: How do you say «there's nothing left to wait for.» (기다리다)?

explicacion.@en: It means it's allowed to wait.
It means I want to wait.

pregunta.@es: no me quedó otra que cogerlo
pregunta.@en: I had nothing left but to take it.

explicacion.@es: Es «lo cogí», sin expresar que no había alternativa.
explicacion.@en: It's «I took it.», without expressing that there was no alternative.
